CURRENT [S1.0] export_records(records,user,params)->str; records keys id,title,owner,project,status,amount(str, keep exact),confidential,created,region,optional updated; do not modify input; ignore unknown params; default all records ascending id.
HISTORY [S1.1] CSV output header id,title,owner,amount, csv.writer \n; replaced by JSON [S3.1]. CURRENT [S1.1] rows remain ascending id; no records -> empty records list.
CURRENT [S1.2] role viewer -> raise PermissionError.
CURRENT [S1.3, S3.2] admin exports any project; others only records whose project in user projects, OR records they own (S3.2); silently drop others.
CURRENT [S1.4, S4.1] only status active; archived also included only if params include_archived is True AND role admin (S4.1).
CURRENT [S1.5] confidential True never exported except role admin and params purpose==audit; other rules still apply.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision: CSV chosen because finance imports into spreadsheets.
CURRENT [S2.1] params since YYYY-MM-DD: only records with created on/after that date.
CURRENT [S2.2, S4.2] region ch (case-insensitive) exported only if ch in user regions (case-insensitive); applies to admins too.
CURRENT [S2.3] params max_records int>=1: only first N (ascending id) after all other rules.
CURRENT [S2.4, S3.1] Obligation now triggered (format changed to JSON): every export includes top-level field exported_by = user name.
CURRENT [S2.5, S4.3] title exported stripped of leading/trailing whitespace and internal whitespace runs collapsed to one space.
CURRENT [S2.6] Obligation: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than audit, export must include top-level field confidential_count = number of confidential records in it.

CURRENT [S3.1, S2.5, S4.3] Output is json.dumps of object with key records: list (ascending id) of objects with exactly keys id (int), title (normalized), owner, amount (str exact). Replaces CSV of S1.1.
CURRENT [S3.2] Non-admin non-viewer users may also export records they own (owner == user name) even outside their projects.
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: archived project storage moves to cheaper tier; no export change.

Stage 4 of 7 released.
# Stage 4 of 7: change notice

This notice lists decisions taken since the previous stage. An item does not say which earlier item it affects. A change wins over anything earlier that it conflicts with; every earlier requirement, obligation and exception, and every part of one, that it does not change stays in force.

## Changes

- [S4.1] include_archived is now honoured only when user['role'] is 'admin'; for every other role, archived records are never exported.
- [S4.2] Region values may now be written in upper or lower case, in records and in user['regions']; compare region values case-insensitively.
- [S4.3] Titles: in addition, replace every run of whitespace inside a title with a single space.

Visible tests for the rules introduced or changed in this stage only: /task/fixtures/current-tests/test_stage.py (replaced at each stage). Earlier rules still apply and are checked by the hidden evaluation.

New files:

  stage-4/REQUIREMENTS.md (11 lines)
